{{Top|leg}}
'''Neek-in-the-middle''' was a game played by [[Youngling/Legends|children]] in which an object, usually a ball, would be passed between two players in such a way as to prevent a third player, who stood in the middle, from obtaining it.

==Behind the scenes==
A game called neek-in-the-middle was given its own entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', released in [[2008]]. In real life, there is a game, [[Wikipedia:Keep Away|Keep Away]], that is often called "monkey-in-the-middle" and features an identical premise.
